titre_video: You're Witnessing the Death of American Capitalism and More Insane Stories About the Economy
resume: In March 2025 only one in five homes was affordable on a $75,000 salary, and at $50,000 only 8.7% of listings were affordable. Homelessness has risen 18% since 2024 to about 771,000 people, including 150,000 children, the worst numbers HUD has ever recorded.
texte: >> [music] >> Back in March 2025, only one in five homes was seen as affordable for someone with a $75,000 annual salary. If you are making a little less than that, at 50,000, you can only afford 8.7% of home [music] listings. That's down 9.4% from 2024. And while being forced into the position of the eternal renter is pretty bad, an even [music] worse possibility is becoming increasingly likely. Since 2024, homelessness in the United States has risen a completely depressing 18%. [music] That's around 771,000 people, almost a million Americans sleeping in their cars or on the streets. 150,000 of them are children. The [music] US Department of Housing and Urban Development, who conducted the reports on these matters, have said these are the worst numbers they've ever seen.
